thread:
alex: heads-up — scheduling a short rolling maintenance for the routing control plane in us-west1 tomorrow 03:00–03:30 UTC. This swaps a kernel blob for routing reconciliation and runs a prefix-cache compaction. Expected user-visible risk: brief spikes in 5xxs (~30–90s) on a handful of nodes during each shard restart.

maya (oncall): ack. will you include the canary scope? i can take first-wave monitoring.

alex: canary = 3% of traffic routed to fallback pool (dedicated-fallback-usw1). We'll run a single-node canary for 20m, then rolling restarts. If error rate > 2% sustained for 2m we abort and rollback.

samir (sre-lead): add this to runbook:
- Preflight: confirm routing table checksum parity (cmd: `./tools/routing-check --region=us-west1`)
- Canary: node id `usw1-canary-07` only
- Gate: alert if 5xx rate > 2% OR p95 latency +50ms over baseline
- Rollback: `deployctl rollback routing-blob --region=us-west1 --to=previous`
- Post: validate prefix cache size + kv-misses

lia (support): i'll draft customer-facing copy for affected Dedicated customers. want it targeted only to those with pinned capacity in us-west1, right?

alex: yes — targeted email and statuspage component update. Also DM account owners via AE.

nate (product): add note that hosted API customers should see no degradation except transient errors for requests hitting the affected nodes. Keep messaging precise.

alex: exact customer copy draft below — pls review quickly: 
```
Planned maintenance: routing reconciliation and cache compaction in us-west1
Window: 03:00–03:30 UTC (tomorrow)
Impact: Most requests will be unaffected. We expect short, isolated request errors or small latency increases for customers with dedicated capacity pinned to us-west1. We will perform a canary and a rolling restart; if we detect elevated errors we will rollback immediately.
What we’re doing: swapping an updated routing blob to improve reconciliation reliability and compacting in-memory prefix caches to reduce long-term latency variance.
No action required. If you rely on strict SLAs for this region, please reply to this message and we’ll coordinate a maintenance exclusion or dedicated fallback.
```

lia (support): small wording tweak: replace 'request errors' -> 'brief request failures (5xx)'. otherwise LGTM.

samir (sre-lead): ops checklist note: ensure `incident-bot` alert rule for us-west1-routing is ENABLED during window and set to page at medium severity.

incident-bot: alert rule `usw1-routing-5xx` set to paging: medium.

ops-bot: preflight task created: `maintenance/usw1-routing-1755003210` assigned to maya, samir, alex.

maya (oncall): preflight done: routing-check OK, canary node reachable, metrics stream green. starting canary at 03:00 UTC. i'll post live updates here.

alex: thanks. quick note for oncall: if p95 latency delta > +50ms AND 5xx > 2% simultaneously for 2m, trigger rollback and notify customers. Use `#incidents` for any visible customer outage.

maya (oncall): understood. will page eng-oncall if we see sustained failures.

samir (sre-lead): post-maint tasks: collect `prefix_cache_size`, `kv_miss_rate`, and routing checksum. add to the maintenance ticket.

lia (support): preparing outbound email now; will ping AEs to send targeted DM. ETA 30m.

nate (product): statuspage component "us-west1 routing" draft: "Degraded — brief intermittent errors possible during scheduled maintenance". Lia pls review tone.

lia (support): will keep it conservative. set visibility to only pinned Dedicated customers + public note.

alex: final: canary started on schedule, monitoring closely. will update thread after rolling completes or if we hit gate. :thumbsup:

maya (oncall): 03:12 UTC — canary complete, no gate tripped. starting rolling restarts now (1 node every 4m).

maya (oncall): 03:23 UTC — node 4 triggered brief 60s spike to 5xx 1.8%, p95 +60ms but 5xx < 2% threshold. continuing but watching.

samir (sre-lead): ok to continue with close watch. keep rollback command ready.

maya (oncall): 03:29 UTC — rolling finished. running postchecks. collecting metrics.

maya (oncall): 03:34 UTC — postchecks OK. prefix cache sizes reduced ~12%, kv-miss rate stable. no rollback.

alex: excellent. lia pls send final completion note and update statuspage to "Operational" with short follow-up.

lia (support): sent completion email to pinned customers and updated statuspage. copy: "Maintenance complete — operations normal. Contact support if you see issues"

nate (product): recommend we schedule a short retrospective tomorrow for latency variance monitoring improvements.

samir (sre-lead): added retro to agenda. closing maintenance ticket now.

ops-bot: maintenance `maintenance/usw1-routing-1755003210` marked complete by maya.
